summary: The RPM installer pre-flight fails if `/tmp`, `/var` or `/var/tmp` (and `/home` for containerized) are mounted `noexec`; remount without it to install. Afterwards you can re-add `noexec` to `/tmp` and `/var/tmp` if you move the controller "Job execution path" (Settings > Jobs settings) elsewhere, but the file system holding `/var/lib/awx` must never be `noexec`.
questions: AAP install fails because /tmp is mounted noexec
Can I use noexec on /tmp with automation controller?
How do I change the job execution path in controller?
Jobs fail in execution environments with noexec /var

answer_card.title: noexec and AAP
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Remount `/tmp`, `/var`, `/var/tmp` (and `/home` for containerized) **without** `noexec`, then install.
2. Optionally re-add `noexec` to `/tmp` and `/var/tmp`.
3. In the controller UI: **Settings > Jobs settings > Job execution path**, set a directory without `noexec`.

`/var` (holding `/var/lib/awx`) must never be `noexec`, or jobs can't run in execution environments.
